h2: Explore every Porta Cabin size & its applications
intro: Six standard sizes, one specification: pick the footprint that matches how you'll use it, with fixed base prices and delivery in 7–21 working days.

panels.h3: 10x10 ft Porta Cabin — 100 sq ft Guard & Utility Room
panels.paragraph: The 10x10 ft cabin packs 100 sq ft into a square plan at the standard 8.5 ft height. It costs ₹1,43,750 ex-GST. The ₹1,437.50 per sq ft small-size rate carries the fixed cost of a full chassis, door, window and electricals in the smallest shell. Use it as a gate security point, a sample room or a single-desk site office. Because the footprint is square, it also fits tight plot corners where longer bodies cannot turn.
applications: Security and watchman cabins at gates and parking areas
panels.imageAlt: Approved 10x10 ft porta cabin GA plan: one door, three windows, four workstations, four seats

panels.h3: 20x8 ft Porta Cabin — Narrow 160 sq ft Roadside Office
panels.paragraph: At 20x8 ft you get 160 sq ft in a narrow rectangle for ₹2,20,000 ex-GST. The 8 ft width follows plot edges, compound walls and road-facing margins. A 10 ft deep body often will not fit there. Plan it as a linear office, a store room or a ticket row, with the door and windows on the long face. As a result, buyers on tight urban plots often pick this size over 20x10 for the slimmer body alone, at the ₹1,375 per sq ft rate.
applications: Site offices on narrow or congested plots
panels.imageAlt: Approved 20x8 ft porta cabin GA plan: one door, four windows, three workstations, three seats

panels.h3: 20x10 ft Porta Cabin — India's 200 sq ft Site Office
panels.paragraph: The 20x10 ft cabin is the SAMAN reference configuration. It gives 200 sq ft at ₹2,50,000 ex-GST. Its ₹1,250 per sq ft rate is the costing anchor, and every other size derives from it. The room carries a working site office comfortably: a desk zone at one end, a discussion corner at the other. Compare vendor quotations at this size first. Our published rate and the downloadable specification state exactly what the price includes.
applications: Sales and marketing offices at project sites
panels.imageAlt: Approved 20x10 ft porta cabin GA plan: one door, six windows, five workstations, five seats

panels.h3: 20x12 ft Porta Cabin — 240 sq ft Partitioned Office
panels.paragraph: Choosing 20x12 ft adds two feet of width over the standard office. You get 240 sq ft for ₹2,88,000 ex-GST, at a reduced ₹1,200 per sq ft band rate. The extra width is what makes an internal partition genuinely usable. Project managers pick this size for a private cabin plus an open working bay. Check the approach road before ordering, because wider bodies can attract over-dimension transport conditions. We confirm this with the delivery quotation.
applications: Consultant and engineer cabins with meeting space
Interview and HR cabins at large sites
panels.imageAlt: Approved 20x12 ft porta cabin GA plan: one door, six windows, five workstations, wide central aisle

panels.h3: 30x10 ft Porta Cabin — Two-Zone 300 sq ft Project Office
panels.paragraph: The 30x10 ft cabin delivers 300 sq ft for ₹3,60,000 ex-GST, in the same ₹1,200 per sq ft band as the 20x12. The longer body suits a two-zone plan: an open work area at one end, an enclosed cabin or store at the other. It still moves and places as one factory-finished module. Consequently, it is the practical step for teams that have outgrown 200 sq ft but do not need the full 40 ft body or its freight class.
applications: Project offices with client meeting rooms
panels.imageAlt: Approved 30x10 ft porta cabin GA plan: two doors, eight windows, twelve workstations and seats

panels.h3: 40x10 ft Porta Cabin — 400 sq ft Multi-Room Module
panels.paragraph: At 40x10 ft you reach 400 sq ft for ₹4,75,000 ex-GST, at the ₹1,187.50 per sq ft large-size rate. This is the multi-room module. A typical plan runs reception, office and meeting space along the 40 ft length. Freight follows the 40 ft open-trailer ladder in the Shipping tab. Unloading arrangements are confirmed with your quotation. Share your location early, and we plan the route, placement and lift before dispatch.
panels.imageAlt: Approved 40x10 ft porta cabin GA plan: manager cabin, partition, three doors, twelve workstations
